/*𝚃𝚊𝚖𝚝𝚊𝚛𝚘 𝙲𝚘𝚖𝚙𝚕𝚎𝚝𝚎 𝚂𝙴𝙻 𝚂𝚎𝚝𝚞𝚙 𝚟3.2.6: No 𝚂𝙴𝙻𝚎𝚌𝚝 𝙴𝚗𝚐𝚒𝚗𝚎*/ []

/*Protect Library & Others*/ merge(passthrough(merge(negate(merge(type(uncached(streams),'debrid'), daysSinceRelease > 180 ? quality(streams, 'CAM','TS','TC','SCR') : []), library(streams)), seadex(streams)), 'excluded', 'required', 'limit'), pin(passthrough(message(streams,'includes','🎯 Smart Play'))))

/*SELect 3 Cached Non-Usenet*/ (1*3) !=0 ? negate( merge( perGroup(resolution(negate(merge(library(streams), seadex(streams), type(streams,'usenet','stremio-usenet'), uncached(streams)), streams), '2160p'), 'quality', (count(quality(resolution(negate(merge(library(streams), seadex(streams), uncached(streams)), streams), '2160p'), 'Bluray Remux', 'Bluray'))<=1*3? ceil(1.5*3) : (1*3)) ), perGroup(resolution(negate(merge(library(streams), seadex(streams), type(streams,'usenet','stremio-usenet'), uncached(streams)), streams), '1440p'), 'quality', 1*3), perGroup(resolution(negate(merge(library(streams), seadex(streams), type(streams,'usenet','stremio-usenet'), uncached(streams)), streams), '1080p'), 'quality', ((count(quality(resolution(negate(merge(library(streams), seadex(streams), uncached(streams)), streams), '2160p'), 'Bluray Remux', 'Bluray', 'WEB-DL'))<=1*3 or count(quality(resolution(negate(merge(library(streams), seadex(streams), uncached(streams)), streams), '1080p'), 'Bluray Remux', 'Bluray'))<=1*3) ? ceil(1.5*3) : (1*3)) ), perGroup(resolution(negate(merge(library(streams), seadex(streams), type(streams,'usenet','stremio-usenet'), uncached(streams)), streams), '720p'), 'quality', ((count(quality(resolution(negate(merge(library(streams), seadex(streams), uncached(streams)), streams), '2160p'), 'Bluray Remux', 'Bluray', 'WEB-DL'))<=1*3 or count(quality(resolution(negate(merge(library(streams), seadex(streams), uncached(streams)), streams), '1080p'), 'Bluray Remux', 'Bluray'))<=1*3 or count(quality(resolution(negate(merge(library(streams), seadex(streams), uncached(streams)), streams), '720p'), 'Bluray Remux', 'Bluray'))<=1*3) ? ceil(1.5*3) : (1*3))), perGroup(resolution(negate(merge(library(streams), seadex(streams), type(streams,'usenet','stremio-usenet'), uncached(streams)), streams), '576p', '480p','360p','240p','144p'), 'quality', 1*3), perGroup(resolution(negate(merge(library(streams), seadex(streams), type(streams,'usenet','stremio-usenet'), uncached(streams)), streams), 'Unknown'), 'quality', 1*3)), negate(merge(library(streams), seadex(streams), type(streams,'usenet','stremio-usenet'), uncached(streams)), streams)) : []

/*SELect Q/R Uncached*/ (1*max(0,3)) !=0 ? negate( merge( perGroup(resolution(negate(seadex(streams), uncached(streams)), '2160p'), 'quality', (count(quality(resolution(negate(merge(library(streams), seadex(streams)), uncached(streams)), '2160p'), 'Bluray Remux', 'Bluray'))<=1*max(0,3)? ceil(1.5*max(0,3)) : (1*max(0,3))) ), perGroup(resolution(negate(seadex(streams), uncached(streams)), '1440p'), 'quality', 1*max(0,3)), perGroup(resolution(negate(seadex(streams), uncached(streams)), '1080p'), 'quality', ((count(quality(resolution(negate(merge(library(streams), seadex(streams)), uncached(streams)), '2160p'), 'Bluray Remux', 'Bluray', 'WEB-DL'))<=1*max(0,3) or count(quality(resolution(negate(merge(library(streams), seadex(streams)), uncached(streams)), '1080p'), 'Bluray Remux', 'Bluray'))<=1*max(0,3)) ? ceil(1.5*max(0,3)) : (1*max(0,3))) ), perGroup(resolution(negate(seadex(streams), uncached(streams)), '720p'), 'quality', ((count(quality(resolution(negate(merge(library(streams), seadex(streams)), uncached(streams)), '2160p'), 'Bluray Remux', 'Bluray', 'WEB-DL'))<=1*max(0,3) or count(quality(resolution(negate(merge(library(streams), seadex(streams)), uncached(streams)), '1080p'), 'Bluray Remux', 'Bluray'))<=1*max(0,3)) ? ceil(1.5*max(0,3)) : (1*max(0,3))) ), perGroup(resolution(negate(seadex(streams), uncached(streams)), '576p', '480p','360p','240p','144p'), 'quality', 1*max(0,3)), perGroup(resolution(negate(seadex(streams), uncached(streams)), 'Unknown'), 'quality', 1*max(0,3))), negate(seadex(streams), uncached(streams))) : []

/*Final Q SELection*/ isAnime? ((count(quality(seadex(streams),'HDRip','HC HD-Rip','DVD REMUX','DVDRip','HDTV'))==0 and count(quality(resolution(merge(type(streams,'p2p','http','live','usenet','stremio-usenet'), cached(type(streams, 'debrid'))),'2160p','1440p','1080p','720p'), 'Bluray REMUX','DVD REMUX','Bluray','WEB-DL'))> 2*(min(5, max(0,3)))) ?  quality(streams,'HDRip','HC HD-Rip','DVDRip','HDTV','CAM','TS','TC','SCR'): ((count(quality(seadex(streams),'HDRip','HC HD-Rip','DVD REMUX','DVDRip','HDTV'))>=1 or count(quality(resolution(merge(type(streams,'p2p','http','live','usenet','stremio-usenet'), cached(type(streams, 'debrid'))),'2160p','1440p','1080p','720p'),'Bluray REMUX','Bluray','WEB-DL','WEBRip','HDRip','HC HD-Rip','DVD REMUX','DVDRip','HDTV'))> 1*(min(5, max(0,3))))? quality(streams,'CAM','TS','TC','SCR') : [] )): (count(rseMatched(quality(merge(type(streams,'p2p','http','live','usenet','stremio-usenet'), cached(type(streams, 'debrid'))), 'Bluray REMUX','Bluray','WEB-DL'), 'DE Bluray T1', 'DE Bluray T2', 'DE Bluray T3', 'UHD Bluray T1', 'HD Bluray T1', 'UHD Bluray T2', 'HD Bluray T2', 'UHD Bluray T3', 'HD Bluray T3', 'DE Web T1', 'DE Web T2', 'DE Web T3', 'DE Web Scene', 'Web T1', 'Web T2', 'Web T3', 'Web Scene','Asian T1','Asian T2','Asian T3')) > 1*(min(5, max(0,3))) or count(quality(resolution(merge(type(streams,'p2p','http','live','usenet','stremio-usenet'), cached(type(streams, 'debrid'))),'2160p','1440p','1080p','720p'),'Bluray REMUX','DVD REMUX','Bluray','WEB-DL')) > 2*(min(5, max(0,3)))) ?  quality(streams,'HDRip','HC HD-Rip','DVDRip','HDTV','SCR','TC','TS','CAM','Unknown'): ((count(quality(resolution(merge(type(streams,'p2p','http','live','usenet','stremio-usenet'), cached(type(streams, 'debrid'))),'2160p','1440p','1080p','720p'), 'Bluray REMUX','Bluray','WEB-DL','WEBRip','HDRip','HC HD-Rip','DVD REMUX','DVDRip','HDTV')) > 1*(min(5, max(0,3))))? quality(streams,'CAM','TS','TC','SCR') : [] )

/*Final R SELection*/ merge(count(resolution( merge(type(streams,'usenet','stremio-usenet','http','live','p2p'),type(cached(streams),'debrid')),'2160p','1440p','1080p')) >= min(3*max(0,3), 15)? merge(type(uncached(streams),'debrid'),resolution(merge(type(streams,'usenet','stremio-usenet','http','live','p2p'), type(cached(streams),'debrid')), '720p','576p','480p','360p','240p','144p','Unknown')):count(resolution( merge(type(streams,'usenet','stremio-usenet','http','live','p2p'),type(cached(streams),'debrid')),'2160p','1440p','1080p')) >= min(1.5*max(0,3), 8)? merge(type(uncached(streams),'debrid'),slice(resolution(merge(type(streams,'usenet','stremio-usenet','http','live','p2p'), type(cached(streams),'debrid')), '720p'), 2*max(0,3)),resolution(merge(type(streams,'usenet','stremio-usenet','http','live','p2p'), type(cached(streams),'debrid')),'576p','480p','360p','240p','144p','Unknown')):count(resolution( merge(type(streams,'usenet','stremio-usenet','http','live','p2p'),type(cached(streams),'debrid')),'2160p','1440p','1080p')) > 0? merge(type(uncached(streams),'debrid'),resolution(merge(type(streams,'usenet','stremio-usenet','http','live','p2p'), type(cached(streams),'debrid')),'576p','480p','360p','240p','144p','Unknown')):count(resolution( merge(type(streams,'usenet','stremio-usenet','http','live','p2p'),type(cached(streams),'debrid')),'2160p','1440p','1080p','720p')) >= min(2.5*max(0,3), 12)? merge(type(uncached(streams),'debrid'),resolution(merge(type(streams,'usenet','stremio-usenet','http','live','p2p'), type(cached(streams),'debrid')),'576p','480p','360p','240p','144p','Unknown')):count(resolution( merge(type(streams,'usenet','stremio-usenet','http','live','p2p'),type(cached(streams),'debrid')),'2160p','1440p','1080p','720p')) >= min(1.5*max(0,3), 6)? merge(type(uncached(streams),'debrid'),slice(resolution(merge(type(streams,'usenet','stremio-usenet','http','live','p2p'), type(cached(streams),'debrid')),'576p','480p','Unknown'), 2*max(0,3)),resolution(merge(type(streams,'usenet','stremio-usenet','http','live','p2p'), type(cached(streams),'debrid')),'360p','240p','144p')):count(resolution( merge(type(streams,'usenet','stremio-usenet','http','live','p2p'),type(cached(streams),'debrid')),'2160p','1440p','1080p','720p')) >0? merge(type(uncached(streams),'debrid'),resolution(merge(type(streams,'usenet','stremio-usenet','http','live','p2p'), type(cached(streams),'debrid')),'360p','240p','144p')):count(resolution( merge(type(streams,'usenet','stremio-usenet','http','live','p2p'),type(cached(streams),'debrid')),'2160p','1440p','1080p','720p','576p','480p','360p','240p','144p','Unknown')) >0? merge(type(uncached(streams),'debrid')): [])
/* Exclude WEBRip When Better Quality Exists */ count(   quality(     streams,     'Bluray REMUX',     'Bluray',     'WEB-DL'   ) ) > 0   ? quality(streams, 'WEBRip')   : []

includedStreamExpressions.expression: /* Pick top Arabic-subtitled P2P (5+ seeders) + HTTP streams, max 5 */ passthrough(   slice(     merge(       slice(quality(resolution(subtitle(merge(seeders(type(streams, 'p2p'), 5), type(streams, 'http')), 'Arabic'), '2160p'), 'Bluray REMUX'), 0, 1),       slice(quality(resolution(subtitle(merge(seeders(type(streams, 'p2p'), 5), type(streams, 'http')), 'Arabic'), '2160p'), 'Bluray'), 0, 1),       slice(quality(resolution(subtitle(merge(seeders(type(streams, 'p2p'), 5), type(streams, 'http')), 'Arabic'), '2160p'), 'WEB-DL'), 0, 1),        slice(quality(resolution(subtitle(merge(seeders(type(streams, 'p2p'), 5), type(streams, 'http')), 'Arabic'), '1080p'), 'Bluray REMUX'), 0, 1),       slice(quality(resolution(subtitle(merge(seeders(type(streams, 'p2p'), 5), type(streams, 'http')), 'Arabic'), '1080p'), 'Bluray'), 0, 1),       slice(quality(resolution(subtitle(merge(seeders(type(streams, 'p2p'), 5), type(streams, 'http')), 'Arabic'), '1080p'), 'WEB-DL'), 0, 1),        slice(quality(resolution(subtitle(merge(seeders(type(streams, 'p2p'), 5), type(streams, 'http')), 'Arabic'), '2160p'), 'Unknown'), 0, 1),       slice(quality(resolution(subtitle(merge(seeders(type(streams, 'p2p'), 5), type(streams, 'http')), 'Arabic'), '1080p'), 'Unknown'), 0, 1),        slice(quality(resolution(subtitle(merge(seeders(type(streams, 'p2p'), 5), type(streams, 'http')), 'Arabic'), 'Unknown'), 'Bluray REMUX'), 0, 1),       slice(quality(resolution(subtitle(merge(seeders(type(streams, 'p2p'), 5), type(streams, 'http')), 'Arabic'), 'Unknown'), 'Bluray'), 0, 1),       slice(quality(resolution(subtitle(merge(seeders(type(streams, 'p2p'), 5), type(streams, 'http')), 'Arabic'), 'Unknown'), 'WEB-DL'), 0, 1),        slice(quality(resolution(subtitle(merge(seeders(type(streams, 'p2p'), 5), type(streams, 'http')), 'Arabic'), 'Unknown'), 'Unknown'), 0, 1)     ),     0,     5   ),   'subtitle',   'excluded' )
